source: Create a large, grand futuristic race track with a sleek metallic sci-fi aesthetic. The track should be a sprawling multi-section circuit with the following features: - A wide main track surface with clean white/silver metallic appearance - Glowing blue energy strips running along the edges of the track (neon-like accent lines) - Multiple curved sections and turns forming a complete circuit loop - Ramps and elevation changes for dynamic racing - A tunnel section with glowing blue interior lighting - Decorative side barriers with sci-fi styling - Start/finish line area with a futuristic archway gate - Tiered grandstand seating area on one side - Support pillars and structural elements with metallic sci-fi design - Blue energy accents and holographic-style decorations throughout The overall style should evoke Mass Effect or Star Wars podracing — clean surfaces, blue energy accents, and a grand sense of scale. Expose these editable attributes: - TrackWidth (how wide the track surface is) - TrackLength (overall scale of the circuit) - NeonColor (the color of the glowing energy strips and accents) - SurfaceColor (the main track surface color) - BarrierHeight (height of the side barriers) - GlowIntensity (brightness of the neon accents)
scene_prompt: Create a large, grand futuristic racing circuit with a sprawling multi-section loop. The wide main track has clean white and silver metallic surfaces, glowing blue energy strips along both edges, sci-fi side barriers, sweeping curved turns, ramps, and elevation changes. Include a blue-lit tunnel section, a start/finish area beneath a futuristic archway gate, and tiered grandstand seating along one side. Metallic support pillars and structural elements frame elevated sections, with blue energy accents and holographic-style decorations distributed throughout the circuit for a sleek, high-tech sense of scale.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Racing: the original request specifies a complete race circuit rather than an explorable sci-fi environment.

### Shape and preset
Use `route-multitier`, a single continuous closed circuit whose ramps, elevated spans, and tunnel create vertically separated track sections. Preset: none. Circuit Racing is the semantic starting point, but the requested multi-tier structure replaces its flat `route-circuit` shape and does not call for its starting grid, lap markers, or turnaround.

### Config requirements
Use `startpoint-line` as visible start markings beneath the futuristic archway and an invisible race-start marker at that location. Use `trigger-finish` as the visible start/finish stripe and archway threshold plus its invisible finish-detection zone. Use `barrier-guardrail` as continuous sleek metallic sci-fi side barriers along exposed track edges. Use `spectator-zone` as the visible tiered grandstand on one side of the circuit. These are the only invisible elements; all track, barriers, tunnel, seating, lighting, and holographic decoration are visible geometry.

### Layout components
Build one large looping circuit, broad enough to read as a grand high-speed route, with a prominent start/finish straight in the foreground or lower frame beneath a luminous futuristic arch. The route sweeps through several broad curved turns, then rises through ramps onto elevated metallic spans supported by substantial sci-fi pillars before descending into a blue-lit enclosed tunnel and returning to the start straight without ambiguous crossings. The track surface is clean white and silver metal; glowing blue energy strips trace both outer edges continuously. Place the tiered grandstand parallel to one long visible side of the main straight, outside the guardrails. Distribute holographic-style accents and blue energy details around the arch, tunnel mouth, pillars, and major turns, without obscuring the drivable surface. The boundary is formed by the track-side barriers and the open futuristic void or minimal platforming beyond them. Compose the full loop legibly from an elevated three-quarter view, with the start arch and grandstand as foreground scale anchors and elevated sections clearly separated.

### Render order
Use `authored_plan`: a racing circuit must be valid by construction as one closed, connected, non-ambiguous route. Generate the circuit blueprint first as authoritative, then produce top-down and isometric renders dressed with the sci-fi architecture.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is large, driven by the sprawling multi-section loop, long turns, elevated structures, tunnel, and grandstand. Theme is grand clean metallic sci-fi, white/silver surfaces, luminous blue energy, Mass Effect or podracing-inspired. Use `P6` for the valid closed racing route and `P2` because elevated track spans and the tunnel create overhanging, vertically occluding surfaces.
